baseline.model: plane stress, homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity
baseline.support: ux=uy=0 along the whole left edge

meshing.generator: Python triangle interface, constrained polygon triangulation
meshing.implementation_status: not yet implemented or executed by this drafting task
notes: Insert all listed boundary split points as constrained segment endpoints on every mesh, even for baseline cases.
Preserve polygon vertices and empty holes; permit boundary subdivision.
Refinements are not assumed nested. Archive generated nodes, elements, markers, mesher version, options and actual quality.
Reuse identical nodes/elements for load and support variants.

geometry.fixed: baseline physical settings and middle mesh-area limit

mesh.fixed: baseline physical case on each object

magnitude.fixed: same mesh, full right edge and full clamp

location.fixed: same mesh, full clamp and equal patch length

supports.fixed: same mesh and full-edge baseline load

observables.mean_right_ux: Integral of ux over the entire right edge divided by its length; integrate the piecewise linear boundary trace.
observables.right_midpoint: Evaluate ux and uy at (right_x, 0.5) m.
observables.solver_metrics: Reuse current Section 3 without changing timing, stopping, method set or counting conventions.
observables.conditioning: Section 2 eigenvalue estimates and defects; report failures.
observables.validation: Mesh geometry, supported symmetry/positive definiteness, prescribed values, constrained reactions, global force and moment balance, same-mesh reference residual.
observables.not_results: No mesh, displacement, timing or convergence output is supplied by this specification.
observables.solution_source: Checked same-mesh sparse-LU reference, not an unconverged iterative approximation; deformed outlines use this reference too.

refinement_comparison.statistic: Absolute differences in metres between consecutive area-limit levels; retain both signed values as well.
refinement_comparison.relative_difference: Not used by default, avoiding division by zero or nearly zero midpoint components. Any optional scaled metric must state its nonzero physical scale.
refinement_comparison.algebraic_uncertainty: For each scalar observable w^T x, estimate uncertainty as ||w||_2 ||b-Ax_ref||_2 / lambda_min_est using its actual interpolation or edge-integration weights. Compare the mesh difference with the sum of estimates from the two meshes. This estimate is not a certified bound unless lambda_min has a certified lower bound; it omits assembly and modelling uncertainty.
refinement_comparison.resolution_rule: Report differences at or below the summed algebraic estimates as unresolved; do not infer a convergence rate from them. A missing/unreliable eigenvalue estimate leaves this resolution check unverified. If the comparison depends on differences near these estimates, confirm with a higher-precision reference before drawing a conclusion.

proposed_acceptance.status: Proposed execution criteria, not implemented or passed tests; not derived from Section 4 observed imbalances.

positive_definiteness.structural: Check positive thickness, admissible material, nondegenerate conforming triangles, edge-connected solid and constraints removing all three planar rigid motions. This supplies the structural SPD argument.
positive_definiteness.small_systems: For at most 2000 free components, additionally require successful dense Cholesky of the supported matrix after symmetry check.
positive_definiteness.large_systems: Compute smallest algebraic eigenpair with eigsh(which=SA). Require reported convergence, normalized eigenpair defect <= 1e-8, and lambda_est > 10*||A v-lambda_est v||_2/||v||_2. This is a diagnostic supporting the structural argument, not a certified proof of lambda_min.
positive_definiteness.failure: Failed/nonconverged diagnostics mean unverified; do not silently treat them as passed or automatically equate eigensolver failure with indefiniteness.

reference_residual.guard: All proposed cases have nonzero b; use original unrounded arrays.

supports.metric: max absolute prescribed displacement discrepancy, metres
supports.scope: All prescribed components, which are zero in these cases.

force_balance.reaction_scope: r is nonzero only at constrained components; include all original applied loads, including those at constrained components.

moment_balance.L_char: Bounding-box diagonal in metres of the undeformed object.
moment_balance.guard: Do not normalize by the net applied moment, which can vanish. Force scale must be positive.

proposed_acceptance.outcome: Record each check separately. Do not admit a failed or unverified reference into physical/refinement plots as validated. Solver failure records still belong in solver comparisons.
